description:
Love(or being in love) is a wonderful thing that colors our life, but love is not always visible and sometimes is vague and ephemeral.

This film is filled with love and shows the state of being carried away by love. However it is almost impossible to understand each other completely even though they loved each other very very much and sometimes it causes heartbreaking.

I expressed vanity of such a heartbreaking love using ceaseless metamorphosis technique. And when this film is completed, my boyfriend left me.

(Source: Official Youtube Channel)
